visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Last Value Disappears
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Removing duplicates from the sorted array 1 1 2 3 3 3 4 should give 1 2 3 4, but the 4 is missing.

solution.explanation: The loop must visit every index up to n - 1, so the condition is read < n. With read < n - 1 the last element is never examined, and a unique last value is lost.
